observations: Photo shows a car engine bay/engine assembly laid out on the ground (no full vehicle body shown).
Multiple hoses, wiring, intake/exhaust components, and engine covers are visible; some parts look disconnected/removed.
No readable engine serial/model plate, no VIN, and no clear brand badge visible in the photo.
Seller text says “Lexus lx460 car Japan engine”, but the photo does not show “LX460” or “Lexus” markings clearly.

identity.kind: used car engine (claimed Lexus LX460 Japan engine)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an engine assembly but no readable Lexus/LX460 identification (no engine code/plate/VIN visible).

risks.risk: Engine may not be the claimed Lexus LX460 engine (wrong engine code/fitment).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/serial plate (or stamped engine number) plus a photo showing the engine model label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unverified used engine with unknown fitment (worst-case: may not match LX460).

risks.risk: Unknown running condition (may be dead, seized, or have internal damage).
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking and running (cold start if possible), plus a short sound check and smoke check.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: treated as not working).

risks.risk: Missing parts / incomplete assembly (some components may be removed).
risks.proof: A full inventory photo/clip of all major components included (intake, alternator, starter, sensors, ECU if included) laid out and counted.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/parts may be missing (worst-case: buyer may need replacements).

risks.risk: Transmission/ECU/ancillaries not included or not compatible (if seller is offering only engine).
risks.proof: Confirm exactly what is included: engine only vs engine + ECU + harness + starter/alternator + sensors; provide photos of each item.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as engine only with unknown included ancillaries (worst-case: buyer must source extras).

risks.risk: Potential scam/overclaim (photos could be generic engine parts not tied to the claimed vehicle).
risks.proof: Provide proof of ownership and matching engine number to the claimed vehicle (paperwork + engine number photo).
risks.if_unproven: Priced conservatively due to mismatch/scam risk (worst-case: not as described).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine number/engine code stamped on the block (and any label/plate).
Video of the engine cranking and running (showing no abnormal knocking and minimal smoke).
Photos showing what exactly is included in the sale (engine only vs engine + ECU + harness + starter/alternator + sensors).
Any paperwork or proof linking the engine to Lexus LX460 (even a matching engine number on documents).
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly, but it does not provide readable Lexus/LX460 identification or proof of working condition. Without engine code/serial and a running test, the correct fitment and value cannot be priced confidently.
